title: Mean
text: Find mean value of input or sequence of inputs, 2 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Reset port} sets Reset event; {Running mean} sets the option to select running mean, {Find the mean value over} sets the dimension over which the block computes the mean value Each, {Dimension} sets the custom dimension, {Input processing} sets the method to process the input in running mode Columns, {Rounding mode} sets the method of rounding, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action, {Accumulator}, {Output}, {Output Minimum} sets the minimum value the block can output, {Output Maximum} sets the maximum value the block can output and {Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: I
ports.summary: Data input vector | matrix | N -D array

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Mean value along the specified dimension scalar | vector | matrix | N -D array

params.name: Running mean
params.values: Option to select running mean off (default) | on

params.name: Find the mean value over
params.values: Dimension over which the block computes the mean value Each column (default) | Entire input | Each row | Specified dimension

params.name: Input processing
params.values: Method to process the input in running mode Columns as channels (frame based) (default) | Elements as channels (sample based)

params.name: Reset port
params.values: Reset event None (default) | Rising edge | Falling edge | Either edge | Non-zero sample

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: Method of rounding operation Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Method of overflow action off (default) | on

params.name: Accumulator
params.values: Accumulator data type Inherit: Same as input (default) | fixdt([],16,0)

params.name: Output
params.values: Output data type Inherit: Same as accumulator (default) | fixdt([],16,0)

params.name: Output Minimum
params.values: Minimum value the block can output [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Output Maximum
params.values: Maximum value the block can output [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data types off (default) | on
